hero.headline: Every Career Has a Trail.
hero.subheadline: Transition Trails connects aspiring Salesforce professionals with real nonprofit client work — and connects nonprofits with the expertise they need to thrive.

experienceGap.heading: The experience gap is real. We close it.

workforceGap.title: The Workforce Gap
workforceGap.body: Thousands of career changers earn Salesforce certifications every year, but encounter a wall: entry-level jobs require 1-2 years of real experience. Without a first job, they can't get experience; without experience, they can't get the first job. The trail stops abruptly.

capacityGap.title: The Capacity Gap
capacityGap.body: Nonprofits are given powerful software licenses for free, but lack the budgets to hire implementation partners. Without proper configuration, the software becomes a burden rather than an accelerator. Their trail is overgrown.

bridge.title: The Bridge
bridge.body: We connect these two needs. By providing supervised, real-world project environments, learners gain verifiable experience while nonprofits receive custom implementations.

nonprofitSection.heading: Your mission deserves technology that works.
nonprofitSection.body: You have the Power of Us grant. You have a team that cares. What you may not have: the expertise to implement Salesforce and keep it running. That's not a failure — it's the gap we exist to close.

problems.title: You have Salesforce. You're not using it.
problems.body: You invested in the platform. Without implementation expertise, adoption stalls and the grant feels wasted.

problems.title: Your team is the accidental admin.
problems.body: Someone on staff inherited Salesforce without training. They're doing their best, but they need support.

problems.title: Consulting rates are out of reach.
problems.body: Traditional Salesforce consulting runs $1,000–$3,000/month. Digital Compass starts at $149.

nonprofitSection.ctaHeading: Digital Compass is how we support nonprofits.
nonprofitSection.ctaBody: Digital Compass is our nonprofit Salesforce membership — weekly office hours, project delivery, and expert guidance from $149/month. No consulting retainer. No long-term contract.
